title: Sparsity-preserving means on a homogeneous convex cone
summary: We study two means on the five-dimensional Vinberg cone $Ω$, viewed as a sparse cone of positive definite $3\times3$ matrices. The Cholesky-Vinberg mean is obtained from the simply transitive solvable group $H$ associated with $Ω$. It is $H$-equivariant, and its interpolation curves are geodesics for two flat metric connections with torsion. One of the corresponding metrics is the canonical Hessian metric of the cone.
